g.text: Same bucket as every other auth route.
Same lookup shape as every other auth
Reset is only offered to verified accounts.
429 with seconds remaining if too soon.
Both flows share one otp field on the user
Distinct subject line from the signup
Nothing in this flow asks for or checks the previous password — once the OTP window
opens via AUTH-API-03's reset branch, mailbox possession is the sole factor for
account / OTP sent) let a caller determine
whether a given email is a verified account on
this system — the same pattern as AUTH-API-02'…
Shared OTP Field With Signup Verification
from one otp field, two purposes
A user cannot have a pending signup-verification
code and a pending reset code at the same time —
whichever request ran most recently wins.

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms — a refresh token, a server session, frontend JWT decoding — are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
Depends on AUTH-API-03 for OTP verification and hands off to AUTH-API-06 for the actual password change.
